question: 已完成订单用户的购买品宽如何（品宽=用户购买的不同品类数的平均值，仅统计已完成订单）
gold_sql:
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_id) AS cnt
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE o.status = '已完成'
    GROUP BY o.user_id
)
raw_output:
SELECT AVG(category_cnt) AS avg_category_width
FROM (
    SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS category_cnt
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = '已完成'
    GROUP BY o.user_id
) t;
